defs.def: a large black and white animal like a bear, that lives in China and is very rare 大猫熊；大熊猫

ex.s: Panda Gourmet offers online ordering for takeout, and delivery is now an option.
ex.t: Panda Gourmet提供外卖在线点餐，现在也支持配送。

ex.s: What service is available only at Panda Gourmet?
ex.t: 哪项服务只有Panda Gourmet提供？

ex.s: Since June 2017, right before the ___56___ (arrive) of the two new pandas, Meng Meng and Jiao Qing, I have been helping the panda keepers at the zoo to feel more comfortable and ___57___ (confidence) speaking English.
ex.t: 自2017年6月起，就在两只新熊猫梦梦和娇庆___56___（arrive）到来之前，我一直在帮助动物园的熊猫饲养员更轻松、更___57___（confidence）自信地说英语。

ex.s: Not the pandas, even though ___59___ language used for the medical training instructions is actually English.
ex.t: 不是熊猫，尽管用于医疗训练指令的语言____59____其实是英语。

ex.s: They talk to the flood of international tourists and to ___60___ (visit) Chinese zookeepers who often come to check on the pandas, which are on loan from China.
ex.t: 他们与蜂拥而至的国际游客交流，也与经常前来查看这些从中国租借的熊猫的___60___（visit）来访的中国饲养员交流。

ex.s: So, what are they learning? ___63___ (basic), how to describe a panda’s life.
ex.t: 那么，它们在学什么？（第63空，basic）基本上是如何描述熊猫的生活。

ex.s: It’s been an honor to watch the panda programme develop ___64___ to see the pandas settle into their new home.
ex.t: 看着熊猫项目发展___64___，看到熊猫安顿到新家，是一种荣幸。

ex.s: Now, I’m living out that dream indirectly by helping the panda keepers do their job in English.
ex.t: 现在，我通过帮助熊猫饲养员用英语开展工作，间接实现了那个梦想。

ex.s: The Chinese government recently finalized a plan to set up a Giant Panda National Park(GPNP). ___56___ (cover)an area about three times ___57___ size of Yellowstone National Park, the GPNP will be one of the first national parks in the country.
ex.t: 中国政府最近敲定了一项建立大熊猫国家公园（GPNP）的计划。（第56空，cover）约（第57空）黄石国家公园三倍的面积，GPNP将成为该国首批国家公园之一。

ex.s: The plan will extend protection to a significant number of areas that ___58___ (be)previously unprotected, bringing many of the existing protected areas for giant pandas under one authority ___59___ (increase)effectiveness and reduce inconsistencies in management.
ex.t: 该计划将把保护扩展到大量此前（第58空，be）未受保护的区域，将许多现有大熊猫保护区纳入一个机构之下，（第59空，increase）效率并减少管理上的不一致。

ex.s: The GPNP’s main goal is to improve connectivity between separate ___62___ (population)and homes of giant pandas, and ___63___ (eventual)achieve a desired level of population in the wild.
ex.t: GPNP的主要目标是改善分离的大熊猫（第62空，population）和栖息地之间的连通性，并（第63空，eventual）在野外达到理想的种群水平。

ex.s: The GPNP is intended to provide stronger protection for all the species ____65____ live within the Giant Panda Range and significantly improve the health of the ecosystem in the area.
ex.t: 全球方案计划旨在为生活在大熊猫范围内的____65____所有物种提供更有力的保护,并显著改善该地区的生态系统健康。

ex.s: In April 2017, two giant pandas from China arrived at a zoo in the Netherlands.
ex.t: 2017年4月，两只来自中国的大熊猫来到荷兰的一个动物园。

ex.s: On 30 May, after the preparations were complete, the day finally came when the pandas met their fans for the first time.
ex.t: 5 月 30 日，所有准备工作就绪后，熊猫们终于迎来了与它们的粉丝首次见面的日子。

ex.s: People were excited – the zoo is the only place in the country where it is possible to see pandas.
ex.t: 人们很兴奋——动物园是这个国家唯一能看到熊猫的地方。

ex.s: In fact, the last time there were pandas in the Netherlands was in 1987.
ex.t: 事实上，荷兰上一次有大熊猫是在1987年。

ex.s: And of course, the main reason why they were so excited is that pandas are just so cute!
ex.t: 当然，他们之所以如此兴奋，最主要的原因还是熊猫实在太可爱了！

defs.def: an Asian animal like a raccoon, with reddish-brown fur and a long thick tail 小猫熊，小熊猫（产于亚洲，毛棕红色，尾巴粗长）
